name: Gill Ranch Storage Pipeline

values.EndLocation: Gill Ranch Storage Field, Madera County

researcher_notes: This is not an existing row. The only nearby row is P6250, a whole-system record for Pacific Gas and Electric. The EIA pipeline projects table from August 2026 lists Gill Ranch Storage Lateral, sheet Historical Projects, Excel row 666, as completed in November 2010, 27 miles, 30 inch, 200 MMcf/d, intrastate, sponsor Gill Ranch Storage LLC, California. A California Public Utilities Commission environmental review page from 2008 describes the same pipeline as about 27 miles and 30 inch, running from PG&E Line 401 near Interstate 5 to the compressor site at the storage field in western Madera County (about 25 miles in Fresno County and 2 miles in Madera County). It is a state-regulated line, so no federal filing is expected. Length is 27 miles, about 43 km, which meets the 25 km minimum. The 2008 page mentions up to 650 MMcf/d in the queue note, but the page text read did not state that figure; EIA's 200 MMcf/d is used. Start year of 2010 and operating status rest on the EIA table alone. The 2008 page is a proposal page, so it does not confirm operation. Owner is styled from the EIA sponsor name with no legal-form hit in the owner list; the registry form should be checked. Route not researched; the CPUC environmental documents likely hold route maps. Suggested RouteType: unavailable until a route is drawn.
